description: This Java source file defines an Android activity called Transition3d that demonstrates 3D flip animations between a ListView of photos and a single ImageView. It handles user interactions to animate view transitions using custom 3D rotation animations.

classes.name: Transition3d
classes.description: Main activity class that manages the 3D flip animation between a list of photos and a detailed photo view, implementing click listeners and animation logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, adapters, and event handlers.

methods.name: applyRotation
methods.description: Performs a 3D rotation animation on the container view, triggering view swaps at midpoint.

classes.name: DisplayNextView
classes.description: Inner class as an animation listener that triggers swapping of views once the first half of animation completes.

methods.name: onAnimationEnd
methods.description: Posts a runnable to swap views after the initial rotation completes.

classes.name: SwapViews
classes.description: Runnable that swaps between the list and image views and starts the second half of the rotation animation.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs the visibility switches and initiates the second rotation.
